record.paper_title: Regularity Properties of Sectorial Operators: Counterexamples and Open Problems
record.original_question: Does every C_0-semigroup of positive contractions on a UMD-Banach lattice admit either a strict dilation or a loose dilation in the class of all UMD-spaces?

evidence.quote: Problem 7. Does every C0-semigroup of positive contractions on a UMD-Banach lattice have a strict / loose dilation in the class of all UMD-spaces?

(i) (T(t))t≥0 has a strict dilation in X if for some Y in X there are contractive linear operators J : X → Y and Q: Y → X and an isometric C0-group (U(t))t∈R on Y such that T(t) = QU(t)J for all t ≥ 0.
(ii) (T(t))t≥0 has a loose dilation in X if for some Y in X there are bounded linear operators J : X → Y and Q: Y → X and a bounded C0-group (U(t))t∈R on Y such that T(t) = QU(t)J for all t ≥ 0.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Setup. Let X be a class of Banach spaces. Given a Banach space X ∈ X and a C_0-semigroup (T(t))_{t≥0} of bounded linear operators on X, one says that:

(i) (T(t))_{t≥0} has a strict dilation in the class X if there exist a Banach space Y ∈ X, contractive linear operators J : X → Y and Q : Y → X, and an isometric C_0-group (U(t))_{t∈ℝ} on Y such that
   T(t) = Q U(t) J  for all t ≥ 0;

(ii) (T(t))_{t≥0} has a loose dilation in the class X if there exist a Banach space Y ∈ X, bounded linear operators J : X → Y and Q : Y → X, and a bounded C_0-group (U(t))_{t∈ℝ} on Y such that
   T(t) = Q U(t) J  for all t ≥ 0.

Recall that a Banach space is a UMD-space if martingale differences are unconditional in the corresponding Bochner L^p-spaces (equivalently, the Hilbert transform extends boundedly to L^p(ℝ;X) for some/all p ∈ (1,∞)). A UMD-Banach lattice is a Banach lattice which is a UMD-space.

Question. Let X be a UMD-Banach lattice and let (T(t))_{t≥0} be a C_0-semigroup of positive contractions on X. Does (T(t))_{t≥0} necessarily admit a strict dilation, or at least a loose dilation, in the class of all UMD-spaces?
artifact.category_tag: Dilations of C_0-semigroups on UMD spaces
artifact.status_search_result: No definitive resolution of the dilation problem for C_0-semigroups of positive contractions on UMD-Banach lattices within the class of UMD-spaces was found in the available search results. The question appears to remain open, but no recent authoritative source explicitly confirming its current status was located.

status_evidence.title: Functional calculus and dilation for C_0-groups of polynomial growth
status_evidence.snippet: Studies dilation properties of C_0-groups in UMD-type settings, related to the dilation framework but does not resolve the positive-contraction case on UMD lattices.
status_evidence.claim: Related dilation results exist for C_0-groups of polynomial growth, but not a resolution of the stated problem.

status_evidence.title: Hörmander functional calculus on UMD lattice valued Lp spaces
status_evidence.snippet: Treats functional calculus on UMD-lattice valued Lp spaces; uses dilation-type arguments but does not settle the strict/loose dilation question for positive-contraction semigroups on general UMD lattices.
status_evidence.claim: Subsequent work on UMD lattices does not resolve the stated dilation problem.
